failure: Failure: The analysis does not rule out sub-100-ms priming, priming hidden inside the edge guard, mechanical pinning, or attachment masked by bearing/glass effects. It cannot observe molecular attachment. The selected records are too sparse and sensitivity-unstable to establish delayed priming; no causal or molecular claim follows.
interface: Interface: The observable is first sustained autonomous rotation during the OFF interval, not stator attachment or occupancy. The report uses selected 4-kHz long-axis/PCA angles, cell-level discovery/validation separation, a fixed Savitzky–Golay derivative, thresholds, persistence rule and edge guards. The 44 traces cover 43 unique cells; one cell appears under both forcing directions within the validation grouping, but no cell crosses the discovery/validation split.

claims.title: A held-out motor OFF-window trace screen does not identify robust delayed priming
